3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: After months of promises and schedule conflicts, Vina and I were finally on our way to visit my cousin Rico Toras at his palace in Iza.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I waved out the car window to the crowds of citizens lining the road. Up ahead, the domed library of the university brought back memories -- first of my happy student years there, then of the horrifying way they'd ended.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: I waved out the car window to the crowds of citizens lining the road. Up ahead loomed the domed library of the university.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: The city's main road was straight and impossibly wide, a relic of Markian times when the city was a major trading center.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Under Rico's stewardship, a formidable-looking iron gate had been constructed around the otherwise tranquil palace complex.

11.speaker: Rico Toras
11.text: "Welcome, my cousins! It has been far too long."

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: We walked up to the doors. As soon as the guards opened them, a pair of long-nosed Rizian hunting dogs raced towards us, barking.

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "Stay back, Vina. They might be dangerous."

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: Both dogs promptly sat at attention, still as statues.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: I heard the sound of boots on tile as my cousin Rico approached. He was wearing an olive-green tweed jacket and a flat cap.

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "So it has, Rico. You're looking sporty."

21.speaker: Rico Toras
21.text: "Did Father not tell you? We're going hunting!"

22.speaker: Hugo Toras
22.text: "Your first hunt as king. I wanted it to be a surprise."

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: Hugo appeared from behind his son, a sheepish look on his face.

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I wish we were seeing each other under more pleasant circumstances."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "I enjoyed hunting with you as a child. But I prefer more intellectual pursuits now."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "A welcome surprise indeed. It's been ages since I shot something."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "You know how much I love hunting. But I wanted to have a serious discussion."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "You could've warned us about the canine welcoming committee."

29.speaker: Rico Toras
29.text: "Bella and Bruno wouldn't hurt a fly. They're just overexcited about today's hunt."

30.speaker: Rico Toras
30.text: "What do you mean? An afternoon in the woods killing boars sounds like the definition of pleasant to me."

31.speaker: Rico Toras
31.text: "I trust Father informed you of today's plans? We leave for the woods in an hour."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "I appreciate it. But I was hoping the four of us could have a serious conversation."

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "You know me too well. Let's go shoot something!"

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "It's a barbaric sport. I prefer more intellectual pursuits."

35.speaker: Hugo Toras
35.text: "We'll have plenty of chances for that. Nine-tenths of this sport is waiting, after all."

36.speaker: Hugo Toras
36.text: "Hunting requires a keen eye and a keener mind. Done properly, it's the most intellectual pursuit there is."

38.speaker: Rico Toras
38.text: "You'll be glad to know the technology has greatly improved since then."

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: He turned around and showed us the KA-74 automatic rifle strapped to his back. Hugo turned up his nose disapprovingly.

41.speaker: Rico Toras
41.text: "Boars are speedy bastards. You'd be surprised, Your Highness."

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: He smiled rakishly at my daughter.

43.speaker: Rico Toras
43.text: "You're behind the times, Father. Who needs a keen mind when you have this?"

44.speaker: Rico Toras
44.text: "As His Majesty proclaims, so it shall be!"

46.speaker: Hugo Toras
46.text: "We have outfits prepared for the two of you. And your choice of weapons, of course."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "I want a KA-74, same as Rico."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "It'll be a good old-fashioned rifle for me."

49.speaker: Rico Toras
49.text: "See, Father? We'll have bagged a dozen boars before you've even finished loading."

50.speaker: Hugo Toras
50.text: "You see, boy, there are still real gentlemen in this world."

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: Inside, Vina and I quickly refreshed ourselves and changed into the hunting garb that had been laid out for us. We stepped out to find two waiting jeeps.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: I turned away from the window to see Rico looking at me intently.

57.speaker: Rico Toras
57.text: "You must already know what I'm about to say, Your Majesty."

58.speaker: Rico Toras
58.text: "I remember a time when you were chomping at the bit to speak in front of Su Omina. Now you regard us -- them -- as criminals?"

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "Don't forget to whom you are speaking, Duke Toras. Count yourself lucky I haven't ordered your arrest yet."

63.speaker: Rico Toras
63.text: "I knew you didn't approve of the company I keep here in Iza. But to accuse us -- them -- of terrorism?"

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "I had no other choice. I'm trying to avoid an international incident."

65.speaker: Rico Toras
65.text: "What I meant to say was... the Zille attack wasn't us."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Wehlen has every reason to suspect Su Omina's involvement in what happened. As do I."

68.speaker: Rico Toras
68.text: "Trust me, nobody I know has a clue who was behind the Zille attack."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "I don't need names. The investigation will turn up the truth."

71.speaker: Rico Toras
71.text: "Would you expect anything less of the Duke of Iza?"

72.speaker: Rico Toras
72.text: "The drugs, the violence, the open resistance against our government."

73.speaker: Rico Toras
73.text: "I wanted to thank you for your understanding, Your Majesty."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: I turned away from the window to see my cousin smiling at me.

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "Just between us... did Su Omina plan the attack?"

76.speaker: Rico Toras
76.text: "That's the funny thing. Nobody I've spoken to has a clue who did it."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "A false flag if I ever saw one. Wehlen obviously planned the bombing."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "No need to thank me. I was protecting myself as well."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "What choice did I have? Members of our house must stand by each other."

80.speaker: Rico Toras
80.text: "Killing a few of their own means nothing to them. They're like ants."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Have you no compassion, son? Those are human beings who died."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "Halaita. If it is said, so it is."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Watch your mouth. It's that kind of language that made Wehlen suspect Su Omina in the first place."

87.speaker: Rico Toras
87.text: "Come now, I'll teach you. It'll be great fun."

88.speaker: Vina Toras
88.text: "I do wish I'd known about these plans. I've never so much as held a gun before."

89.speaker: Hugo Toras
89.text: "Why stop there? Why not hire an airplane and shoot them from the sky?"

90.speaker: Rico Toras
90.text: "Nonetheless, I appreciate it. Especially since the organization is entirely innocent in this matter."

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: Vina suddenly tapped me on the shoulder.

93.speaker: Narrator
93.text: His security let us through to the Duke's residence, a blindingly white building with the flags of Rizia and House Toras hanging from every window.

94.speaker: Vina Toras
94.text: "Hugo's meeting us here too, right? Why do you think they wanted us here so badly?"

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "I suspect the Golden Guard investigation I ordered will be the main topic of discussion."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "I have my guesses. We'll see if they're right."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "To see something like those statues, I wager. Give us an inkling of the pressure Rico is under."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "The family hasn't been all together in ages. It's about time."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "The invitation coming so soon after the Zille incident is no coincidence."

103.speaker: Vina Toras
103.text: "I can't even remember the last time Cousin Rico and I properly spoke. When we were children, maybe."

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: We rode on until we reached Palas Sazon.

105.speaker: Rico Toras
105.text: "Caught the scent already, my dears? Must be dozens of boars out there."

106.speaker: Hugo Toras
106.text: "But I've bored you enough, Your Highness. I believe Rico was going to show you the ropes."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "Actually, I was hoping *I* could escort my daughter on her first hunt."

108.speaker: Rico Toras
108.text: "I would be delighted to. If the King permits."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "Go ahead, Vina. I hear Rico is an excellent shot."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "It's not my decision. Do you want to go with him, Vina?"

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: He extended his hand to my daughter.

116.speaker: Narrator
116.text: An assistant handed me my KA-74. It was slightly different than the one I'd handled in my army days, but felt reassuringly familiar.

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: An assistant handed me my rifle. It was a Rizian-made Dator 56, similar to the one I'd used during my summers hunting with Hugo.

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: Vina took Rico's hand. With a smile, he picked up their guns and walked her over to one of the blinds, dogs in tow.

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: An assistant handed me my KA-74. It was much heavier than I expected.

126.speaker: Narrator
126.text: An assistant handed me my rifle. It was a Rizian-made Dator 56. Clunkier than the one I'd used in the military, but usable.
126.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_KA74"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true)

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: An assistant handed me my rifle, a Rizian-made Dator 56. It was more awkward to hold than I expected.
130.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_KA74"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true) == false)

131.speaker: Hugo Toras
131.text: "My son may aim for quantity. But men like us know quality is key."

132.speaker: Hugo Toras
132.text: "You and my son may aim for quantity. But I know quality is key."

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: He locked and loaded his own Dator rifle. Its stock had a gold-embossed bull on it.

134.speaker: Narrator
134.text: We climbed up into the hunting blind opposite of Vina and Rico's position.

135.speaker: Hugo Toras
135.text: "I may not like Rico's hunting methods, but his dogs are second to none. They'll drive the boars out in no time."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Why were you so keen that he and Vina go off together?"

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "Rico's a shrewd kid. Takes after his father."

139.speaker: Hugo Toras
139.text: "If my son and your daughter are to be married, they ought to spend time together first."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "It's up to Vina to choose her own husband. And I doubt her cousin ranks high on the list of candidates."

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: He calmly adjusted his rifle's sight.

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "Of course I have. But the two of them turned out as different as night and day."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "Shockingly enough, the thought never crossed my mind."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "I might have if your son were more of a gentleman."

149.speaker: Hugo Toras
149.text: "Choose your words carefully, Your Majesty. You're referring to the last male scion of House Toras."

150.speaker: Hugo Toras
150.text: "As you know, there are interests both inside and outside this country who seek to snatch Rizia away from House Toras."

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: Just then, we heard a rustling sound coming from the woods. Bella and Bruno had found their quarry.

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: A group of boars raced into the clearing, the dogs nipping at their heels. Working in tandem, they forced their prey into the lowest part of the glade.

158.speaker: Narrator
158.text: As I gripped the KA-74, my military training took over. I fired a flurry of bullets into the group of boars. One after another fell to the ground.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: The assault rifle was more unwieldy than the ones I was used to, but I managed to hit the largest boar.

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: I struggled to keep the gun steady as it unleashed a round of bullets. The boars scattered in all directions.
166.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_KA74"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"]) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true) == false)

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: The largest boar fell to the ground. The others scattered in all directions, squealing.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: My first shot managed to hit the largest boar. I fired again and hit another.
174.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_KA74"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"])

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: I struggled to keep the gun steady as it fired. The shot went wide, and the boars scattered in all directions.
175.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_KA74"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"]) == false)

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: Rico jumped down from his blind and raced into the clearing. The dog lay on his side, whimpering.

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: The others squealed as they scattered. A flurry of bullets came from Rico's blind, and one boar after another fell to the ground.

180.speaker: Hugo Toras
180.text: "Not very sporting, if you ask me."

181.speaker: Narrator
181.text: As I turned away to reload, I heard a series of rapid-fire bangs coming from Rico's direction. I looked back out of the blind to see the ground littered with dead boars.

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: By the end of the hunt, I'd racked up six kills. Hugo had four, and Rico had a dozen.

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: By the end of the hunt, Hugo had four kills and Rico and I had both racked up about a dozen.

184.speaker: Narrator
184.text: He and my daughter were deep in conversation as they climbed down from their blind.

185.speaker: Hugo Toras
185.text: "Hmph. Not very sporting, if you ask me."

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: By the end of the hunt, I had zero kills. Hugo had six, and Rico had racked up a dozen.

187.speaker: Rico Toras
187.text: "Lyza this, Lyza that. I'm telling you, if the Wehlen Civil War had happened while Grandmother was still in power, she wouldn't have set out the welcome mat."

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: My shot went just wide of where the boars were. They scattered in all directions, squealing.

193.speaker: Hugo Toras
193.text: "Been too long, has it? Allow me."

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: As I turned away to reload, I heard a series of rapid-fire bangs coming from Rico's direction. I looked back out of the blind to see the ground littered with dead boars.

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: I got through the rest of the hunt without any additional kills. Hugo racked up four; Rico, a dozen.

196.speaker: Hugo Toras
196.text: "Not very sporting, if you ask me."

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: In one swift motion, he aimed and fired his rifle. The largest of the boars fell to the ground.

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: As we turned away to reload, I heard a series of rapid-fire bangs coming from Rico's direction. I looked back out of the blind to see the ground littered with dead boars.

199.speaker: Narrator
199.text: By the end of the hunt, I'd racked up four kills. Hugo had six, and Rico had a dozen.

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: By the end of the hunt, I'd racked up six kills. Hugo had four, and Rico had a dozen.

202.speaker: Narrator
202.text: As I turned away to reload, I heard a series of rapid-fire bangs coming from Rico's direction. I looked back out of the blind to see the ground littered with dead boars.

203.speaker: Hugo Toras
203.text: "Hmph. Not very sporting, if you ask me."

204.speaker: Hugo Toras
204.text: "Hmph. Not very sporting, if you ask me."

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: I heard a squeal, then a thud. To my surprise, I'd hit one of the boars.
208.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_KA74"] == true) == false)

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: Hugo, Vina and I climbed down as Rico frantically ripped off a piece of his shirt and wrapped it tight around Bruno's bleeding leg.

210.speaker: Rico Toras
210.text: "What the hell, cousin? You shot my dog!"

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "You will refer to me as 'Your Majesty'."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "It's not my fault. I was aiming for the boar."

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "It was my first time with a KA-74. I got flustered."

219.speaker: Vina Toras
219.text: "Why not? I've had enough father-daughter time lately."

220.speaker: Vina Toras
220.text: "Yes, I'd love to. We didn't even get a chance to speak at the coronation."

222.speaker: Vina Toras
222.text: "I'm telling you, if Wehzeks and Derdians were granted the same rights as native Rizians, none of this would be happening."

226.speaker: Vina Toras
226.text: "No! Lyza would have honored Rizia and Wehlen's long history of cooperation, and shown compassion for those who suffered."

227.speaker: Rico Toras
227.text: "You naive little girl. Everyone in Merkopa wants what we Rizians have. The Wehzeks saw a chance to get it, and they jumped on it."

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: He flung his gun on the ground in frustration.

229.speaker: Rico Toras
229.text: "I'm afraid your daughter didn't shoot a damn thing on today's hunt, Your Majesty. She was too busy distracting me with her nonsense opinions."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "Vina is your intellectual superior in every way, you twit. You will apologize to her. Now."

231.speaker: Rico Toras
231.text: "He can't hunt on three fucking legs!"

232.speaker: Rico Toras
232.text: "Excuse me. His Majesty King Romus Toras shot my fucking dog!"

233.speaker: Rico Toras
233.text: "Next time, aim at your own fucking head!"

238.speaker: Vina Toras
238.text: "Honestly, Father! Why choose such a dangerous weapon if you don't know how to use it?"

239.speaker: Narrator
239.text: Vina bent down and stroked Bruno's fur. The dog raised his head slightly and licked her hand.

240.speaker: Hugo Toras
240.text: "Rico, Vina, why don't you two take Bruno back to the palace? His Majesty and I will wrap everything up here."

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: She put her hand on Rico's shoulder. He forced himself to take a deep breath.

242.speaker: Rico Toras
242.text: "You're right. It'd be worse. Rizia would have collapsed under the strain of providing for its own as well as millions of foreign parasites."

243.speaker: Vina Toras
243.text: "Parasites? They mine our gold and farm our crops, you idiot. If anyone's a parasite, it's the nobles siphoning wealth from their labor."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "You've done well enough for all four of us. Congratulations."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "Vina, we're guests here in Iza. Apologize to Rico now."

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: He seemed to collect himself for a moment, then smirked.

247.speaker: Rico Toras
247.text: "Thank you. You didn't make out too poorly yourself."
247.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_Rifle"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_ShootToMiss"] == true)

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: My uncle gave me a meaningful glance.

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "Yes, you two go on. I'm truly sorry, Rico."

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "Actually, Hugo should go with you. I'll travel with the princess."

251.speaker: Narrator
251.text: Rico seemed to collect himself for a moment.

255.speaker: Rico Toras
255.text: "I accept your apology. And this won't affect the agreement we made today."

256.speaker: Rico Toras
256.text: "I accept your apology. I hope you'll give extra consideration to my police request, however."

257.speaker: Narrator
257.text: Rico seemed like he was about to object, but thought better of it.

261.speaker: Rico Toras
261.text: "As you wish, Your Majesty. This won't affect the agreement we made today."

262.speaker: Rico Toras
262.text: "Go on, then. I hope you'll give extra consideration to my police request, however."

263.speaker: Narrator
263.text: He seemed to collect himself for a moment.

264.speaker: Rico Toras
264.text: "I'm sorry, Your Highness. I must have gotten carried away."

265.speaker: Narrator
265.text: Vina looked sullenly at the ground.

268.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
268.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_Rifle"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_ShootToMiss"] == true)

270.speaker: Rico Toras
270.text: "Thank you. I wish I could say the same to you."

271.speaker: Narrator
271.text: We posed for photographs next to the boars we'd killed. The assistants began packing everything away.

276.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
276.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_Rifle"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Hunting_ShootToMiss"] == true)) == false

277.speaker: Hugo Toras
277.text: "We'll eat well tonight. The chef at Palas Sazon does an excellent braised boar with wine sauce."

278.speaker: Hugo Toras
278.text: "Rico, Vina, why don't you two ride ahead and notify the kitchen staff? His Majesty and I will be right behind you."

279.speaker: Narrator
279.text: Vina gave me a pleading look.

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "Yes, go ahead. One last chance for you two to have a civil conversation before we leave."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "Why don't you go with your son, Hugo? I'll accompany the princess."

284.speaker: Narrator
284.text: Vina grimaced at me as Rico led her to one of the waiting jeeps. Hugo and I got into the second, and the four of us headed back to the palace.

285.speaker: Narrator
285.text: Dinner that night was indeed delicious.

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: Vina silently thanked me as Rico and Hugo departed. We climbed into the second jeep and headed back to the palace.

289.speaker: Narrator
289.text: The assistants carefully placed Bruno on a blanket in the back of one of the jeeps. Hugo and Rico got in, and the car sped away.

290.speaker: Narrator
290.text: Vina and I got into the other jeep and followed them back to the palace.

291.speaker: Narrator
291.text: We left for Porte Drazon without staying for dinner.

292.speaker: Narrator
292.text: The assistants carefully placed Bruno on a blanket in the back of one of the jeeps. Vina and Rico got in, and the car sped away.

293.speaker: Narrator
293.text: Hugo and I got into the other jeep and followed them back to the palace.

294.speaker: Narrator
294.text: He calmly aimed his rifle towards the glade.

296.speaker: Narrator
296.text: I noticed most of the people who'd come out to see us were native Rizian -- even on the streets of the city's Wehzek quarter, Little Wraclawitz.

297.speaker: Narrator
297.text: He gave me a quick bow of acknowledgement, then knelt and kissed Vina's hand. I was struck by his transformation from a gawky, insecure teen to a broad-shouldered, preternaturally confident young man.

302.speaker: Rico Toras
302.text: "What a splendid idea. Remind me to plan that for next time."

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "I'll ride with Duke Rico. I have much to discuss with him."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "Vina, care to share a car with your old man?"

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "Hugo, shall we ride together and let the children catch up?"

307.speaker: Narrator
307.text: Rico nodded. An aide held the door open, and we hopped into the first car.

308.speaker: Rico Toras
308.text: "If you don't mind, Your Majesty, I've had this car prepared for the two of us."

309.speaker: Narrator
309.text: He gestured to his aide, who held the door of the first jeep open. The two of us stepped in.

310.speaker: Narrator
310.text: East of the palace, the landscape quickly turned hilly and green. We were entering the Brenas Forest Estate, a private hunting ground reserved for nobility only.

311.speaker: Rico Toras
311.text: "Well, I humbly request that you try harder."

312.speaker: Rico Toras
312.text: "Whatever you may think of us, Su Omina didn't plan the Zille attack."

313.speaker: Rico Toras
313.text: "Though I can't say I wasn't happy to see those Wehzeks get what was coming to them."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "Halaita. If it is said, so it is."

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "For heaven's sake, son, have some respect for the dead."

316.speaker: Player_Romus
316.text: "You'll get what's coming to you if you carry on with that kind of talk."

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: A light smirk formed on his face.

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "So you want me to believe your organization is completely innocent?"

322.speaker: Rico Toras
322.text: "The point is that your investigation into us will turn up nothing. About Wehlen, at least."

329.speaker: Rico Toras
329.text: "Your investigation into us will turn up nothing."

330.speaker: Rico Toras
330.text: "But if you want this mess cleared up in time for Zille to be returned, I think I can help you."

331.speaker: Rico Toras
331.text: "The point is that President Smolak's accusations are based on nothing. Just his own vendetta against us."

332.speaker: Rico Toras
332.text: "Smolak's accusations are based on nothing. Just his own vendetta against us."

337.speaker: Rico Toras
337.text: "The people in my organization are loyal to me, Your Majesty. Very loyal."

338.speaker: Rico Toras
338.text: "Aside from getting your Golden Guard off Su Omina's tail? Nothing. I wouldn't dare to bargain with my cousin and my King."

340.speaker: Rico Toras
340.text: "If one or two of them were to confess to the attack, as a splinter cell acting independently of both Su Omina and the crown, it'd solve both of our problems."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "So you're offering to commit a crime on my behalf."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "Wehlen's investigators aren't stupid. They'd uncover the truth."

346.speaker: Rico Toras
346.text: "Not if the truth is that Wehlen itself was behind the attack."

347.speaker: Rico Toras
347.text: "My hunch is, they're counting on Rizia to deny the crime so they can postpone the Zille handover."

348.speaker: Rico Toras
348.text: "By handing over my men, we'd be calling their bluff."

349.speaker: Rico Toras
349.text: "In time to get Zille back by the end of the year? I doubt it."

350.speaker: Rico Toras
350.text: "I'm not offering anything. Just pointing out how convenient it would be should such a confession occur."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "Just how loyal are these scapegoats you're proposing? Would they crack under interrogation?"

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "And the fact that this would put a premature end to my investigation into Su Omina? A nice little bonus for you, I presume."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "I appreciate the gesture. But I can't condone this."

357.speaker: Player_Romus
357.text: "I don't care how long it takes. I won't stoop to the kind of tactics you're suggesting."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "It *would* be convenient to put this incident behind us as fast as possible."

359.speaker: Rico Toras
359.text: "Trust me, cousin. If it came down to that, I have the resources to make sure their loved ones are well cared for."

363.speaker: Rico Toras
363.text: "And you as well. Don't forget your own history with us."

364.speaker: Rico Toras
364.text: "And you as well. Don't forget that we're related."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "That's not code, Rico. Come forth with false suspects, and I'll have your head."

370.speaker: Player_Romus
370.text: "*If* it were to emerge that said suspects were lying, the order for them to come forward would never be traceable back to me."

374.speaker: Narrator
374.text: Rico looked away for a moment. The woods around us were growing denser.

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "Actually, no. I won't go along with this plan. Your organization must be held accountable."

379.speaker: Rico Toras
379.text: "Carry on with your investigation and forget I mentioned anything."

380.speaker: Rico Toras
380.text: "I-- well within your right, Your Majesty."

381.speaker: Rico Toras
381.text: "Carry on with your investigation and forget I said anything."

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "Very well, Your Grace. Let's try this your way."

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "I can't believe I'm even entertaining this thought. The answer is no."

385.speaker: Rico Toras
385.text: "I'll make the arrangements as soon as we get back into the city. And thank you in advance for ending that useless investigation."

386.speaker: Rico Toras
386.text: "I'll make the arrangements as soon as we get back into the city. And thank you in advance for ending that useless investigation."

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: We drove on. The woods around us were growing denser.

389.speaker: Player_Romus
389.text: "If there's anything else you'd like to bring up with your king, now is the time."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "How are you faring as Duke of Iza, my cousin? Be honest."

391.speaker: Narrator
391.text: Rico eagerly turned back toward me.

392.speaker: Rico Toras
392.text: "I'm sure you've been kept abreast of the situation here, Your Majesty."

394.speaker: Player_Romus
394.text: "You're not a child, Rico. Pull yourself together and become the leader this city needs."

395.speaker: Player_Romus
395.text: "It doesn't seem that bad to me."

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "It's concerning indeed. What can I do to help?"

398.speaker: Rico Toras
398.text: "I'm trying. But I can't do it without reinforcements."

399.speaker: Rico Toras
399.text: "Sooner or later, it will add up to something greater than its parts."

401.speaker: Rico Toras
401.text: "I've heard that in times of emergency, police from the Rizian central forces can be placed under individual leaders' direct command."

402.speaker: Rico Toras
402.text: "I've petitioned your War and Security Councilor for just such a transfer, but she refused."

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "Rightly so. You should be cooperating with the greater province of Brenas."

404.speaker: Player_Romus
404.text: "So you're using your family connections to go over her head."

405.speaker: Player_Romus
405.text: "She made a mistake. The Brenas police cannot be counted on to help you keep the peace here."

407.speaker: Rico Toras
407.text: "Well... yes. I don't see another alternative."

408.speaker: Rico Toras
408.text: "If anything, they are actively working against me."

410.speaker: Rico Toras
410.text: "They can't be counted on to cooperate. If anything, they're actively plotting against us."

411.speaker: Rico Toras
411.text: "You understand that this city is a bellwether for our house. If we lose it, we lose Rizia."

412.speaker: Rico Toras
412.text: "I'll send you the petition when we are both back home. I trust you to do what's best for our city."

413.speaker: Rico Toras
413.text: "I know the Wehzeks were pressuring you to denounce Su Omina. You very wisely saw their witch hunt for what it was."

414.speaker: Rico Toras
414.text: "Although we weren't sorry to hear those Wehzeks got what was coming to them."

416.speaker: Rico Toras
416.text: "I will let you in on a secret, though."

418.speaker: Player_Romus
418.text: "It's clearly a ruse planned by the Wehzeks themselves."

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "They're upstanding citizens. I can't imagine they would stoop to violence."

421.speaker: Rico Toras
421.text: "You don't have to. But I'm telling you the truth."

422.speaker: Narrator
422.text: Rico contorted his mouth into an approximation of a frown.

423.speaker: Rico Toras
423.text: "Of course. It was a terrible tragedy."

424.speaker: Rico Toras
424.text: "It's just us here in this car, isn't it? We can tell it like it is."

425.speaker: Rico Toras
425.text: "Speaking of which... I'll let you in on a secret."

426.speaker: Rico Toras
426.text: "Just prior to the incident, we were about to activate a branch of Su Omina in Zille."

427.speaker: Rico Toras
427.text: "They'll be exposed soon enough. They aren't intelligent enough to cover their own tracks."

429.speaker: Player_Romus
429.text: "I hope you're not still planning on going through with that."

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "That would have been an idiotic thing to do without the King's permission."

434.speaker: Rico Toras
434.text: "Smolak was never going to hand Zille over on a silver platter. We'll only get back what's ours if we put the screws to him."

435.speaker: Rico Toras
435.text: "The region is teeming with Rizian loyalists anyway. All they need is a spark."

438.speaker: Rico Toras
438.text: "Of course anyone we sent up there would have to operate in total secrecy. But wouldn't it be fun to mess with the Wehzeks?"

439.speaker: Rico Toras
439.text: "No, Your Majesty. Of course you can't."

441.speaker: Rico Toras
441.text: "Nothing as extreme as the bombing, mind you. We'd just spread the word about the benevolence of King Romus."

442.speaker: Player_Romus
442.text: "I already have one pro-Rizian organization active in Zille. I don't need two."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "It wouldn't hurt to have more of an upper hand."

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "Were your group's activities in Zille to be revealed, I would proclaim complete ignorance of them."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "That's not code. If I hear about any Su Omina activity north of the Wehlen border, I'll have your head."

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "Seriously, I appreciate the offer, but I don't want to put your organization at risk."

452.speaker: Rico Toras
452.text: "We wouldn't interfere with whatever you have in motion. We'd simply spread the word about the benevolence of King Romus."

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "A tempting proposition, but I wouldn't want to put you or your organization at risk."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "More people should be aware of my benevolence, it's true."

457.speaker: Player_Romus
457.text: "I'm not like you. I don't need brute force to accomplish my goals."

458.speaker: Rico Toras
458.text: "That should be the least of your worries. We know how to protect ourselves."

460.speaker: Rico Toras
460.text: "You might not *need* it. But it makes for a fine insurance policy."

462.speaker: Narrator
462.text: Rico looked away for a moment. The woods around us were growing denser.

463.speaker: Player_Romus
463.text: "Yes. We are in agreement." [-2 Budget, -250 Military Equipment]

465.speaker: Player_Romus
465.text: "Actually... no. You are to limit Su Omina's activity to within Rizia."

466.speaker: Rico Toras
466.text: "You don't have to get your hands dirty, cousin. Just say the word if you want our assistance."

467.speaker: Player_Romus
467.text: "I don't know how much clearer I can make this. My answer is no."

469.speaker: Rico Toras
469.text: "The Crown has much to gain from this arrangement, Your Majesty. And not only in Zille."

470.speaker: Narrator
470.text: We kept driving. The woods around us were growing denser.

472.speaker: Narrator
472.text: We pulled off the road and continued some distance on a dirt path that wound through the pines.

473.speaker: Narrator
473.text: We came to a halt at the mouth of a grassy clearing with gently sloping sides. Hunting blinds lined its perimeter.

477.speaker: Narrator
477.text: In my youth, Hugo and I had nicknamed it the 'Soup Tureen'."

478.speaker: Narrator
478.text: It vaguely resembled a gigantic serving vessel.

480.speaker: Narrator
480.text: We disembarked and Rico eagerly unlatched the back of our jeep. Bella and Bruno hopped out and started sniffing the air.

481.speaker: Narrator
481.text: The other car pulled up next to us. Hugo and Vina got out, still in conversation.

482.speaker: Hugo Toras
482.text: "...so you see, Your Highness, knowing how to aim and fire a gun correctly is as useful a royal skill as knowing how to hold a salad fork."

483.speaker: Player_Romus
483.text: "Keep at it, Hugo. You'll make a huntress out of my daughter yet."

484.speaker: Player_Romus
484.text: "With the essential difference that lettuce doesn't bleed when you pierce it."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "I trust you two enjoyed the car ride?"

486.speaker: Player_Romus
486.text: "Don't listen to Hugo, Vina. Your uncle's a notoriously terrible shot."

487.speaker: Narrator
487.text: Hugo scowled at me briefly. He waved his son over.

488.speaker: Hugo Toras
488.text: "It's always a pleasure to get to know the princess better."

490.speaker: Hugo Toras
490.text: "I've bored you enough, Your Highness. I believe Rico was going to show you the ropes."

491.speaker: Narrator
491.text: Hugo chuckled politely. He waved his son over.

492.speaker: Hugo Toras
492.text: "With her instincts, she'll be the finest shot this kingdom ever saw."

493.speaker: Hugo Toras
493.text: "Why not let the youngsters have their fun? Old men like us would slow them down."

494.speaker: Rico Toras
494.text: "You're damned right about that, Father. Shall we, Vina?"

495.speaker: Narrator
495.text: He beckoned to Vina again. She hesitantly followed him over to the nearest hunting blind.

497.speaker: Hugo Toras
497.text: "The two of us it is, Your Majesty."

500.speaker: Hugo Toras
500.text: "And now we play the waiting game."

501.speaker: Narrator
501.text: There was a long stretch of silence, punctuated only by the chirping of birds and the occasional bark of Bella and Bruno in the distance.

502.speaker: Player_Romus
502.text: "I can't help but think you and he had an ulterior motive for inviting us here."

503.speaker: Hugo Toras
503.text: "And yet night and day are inseparable."

505.speaker: Hugo Toras
505.text: "Consanguinity wouldn't be my first choice, either. But it's the only way to keep our family in power."

507.speaker: Hugo Toras
507.text: "What are Her Highness' other options? A rival house? A foreign prince? Anyone other than Rico would dilute our family's blood and loosen our grip on the throne."

510.speaker: Hugo Toras
510.text: "But more pressingly, if my son and your daughter are to be married, they ought to spend time together first."

511.speaker: Narrator
511.text: He calmly adjusted his rifle's sight.

512.speaker: Hugo Toras
512.text: "Of course there's the nastiness with Wehlen."

513.speaker: Hugo Toras
513.text: "So you'll consider him as a marriage prospect for your daughter, then?"

514.speaker: Player_Romus
514.text: "I never said that. Vina deserves to marry a gentleman."

515.speaker: Hugo Toras
515.text: "Or have you seriously never considered the possibility?"

516.speaker: Player_Romus
516.text: "You may have a point, but it's still Vina's decision."

517.speaker: Hugo Toras
517.text: "Letting youngsters 'follow their hearts' is a recipe for disaster. My brother was the ultimate example."

518.speaker: Player_Romus
518.text: "Let's see how they get along today before we start making wedding arrangements."

519.speaker: Player_Romus
519.text: "Our family has been in power long enough."

520.speaker: Hugo Toras
520.text: "Not as long as God has preordained."

521.speaker: Hugo Toras
521.text: "Fair enough. Rico can be quite the charmer when he sets his mind to it."

522.speaker: Player_Romus
522.text: "The right alliances can make us more powerful than blood alone."

523.speaker: Hugo Toras
523.text: "And the wrong ones will doom us to history's dustbin."

524.speaker: Hugo Toras
524.text: "As your uncle and your advisor, this is my advice. You may follow or disregard it as you choose."

525.speaker: Narrator
525.text: Looking through my gun sight, I fixed my crosshairs on the group.

526.speaker: Narrator
526.text: My uncle gave me a look of disapproval.

527.speaker: Narrator
527.text: He looked up at me with almost feral eyes.

528.speaker: Hugo Toras
528.text: "For God's sake, Rico, shut your mouth!"

529.speaker: Hugo Toras
529.text: "My deepest apologies, Your Majesty. My son's not in his right mind."

530.speaker: Rico Toras
530.text: "Please excuse my outburst, Your Majesty. I understand you weren't aiming for Bruno."

531.speaker: Rico Toras
531.text: "But what good is a hunting dog who can't hunt?"

532.speaker: Player_Romus
532.text: "You're still holding a gun. Put him out of his misery."

535.speaker: Rico Toras
535.text: "How big of an asshole do you think I am, Your Majesty?"

536.speaker: Player_Romus
536.text: "Put him out to stud. I bet he's got good blood, doesn't he?"

538.speaker: Rico Toras
538.text: "A purebred through and through, Your Majesty."

539.speaker: Rico Toras
539.text: "All right. I'll keep the poor fellow around."

540.speaker: Player_Romus
540.text: "I'll take him, then. I wouldn't mind having a dog around the palace."

543.speaker: Player_Romus
543.text: "I shot the poor fellow. He's my responsibility now."

544.speaker: Player_Romus
544.text: "Who knows what your brute of a cousin will do to him if I don't take him?"

545.speaker: Player_Romus
545.text: "A three-legged royal dog? The public will love it!"

546.speaker: Narrator
546.text: Rico looked down at his dog.

547.speaker: Rico Toras
547.text: "Well, Bruno? You want to go live in Porte Drazon?"

548.speaker: Narrator
548.text: Rico looked at me and shrugged.

549.speaker: Rico Toras
549.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. He eats only raw meat. Venison, if you have it."

553.speaker: Rico Toras
553.text: "Take good care of him. And this won't affect the agreement we made today."

554.speaker: Rico Toras
554.text: "Take good care of him. And I hope you'll give extra consideration to my police request."

555.speaker: Player_Romus
555.text: "You don't care about dead Wehzeks, but you care about an injured dog?"

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "You said it yourself. He's useless on three legs."

558.speaker: Rico Toras
558.text: "No, no. I'll find something to do with him."

560.speaker: Rico Toras
560.text: "Wehzeks are expendable. Bruno is a royal pedigree."

561.speaker: Rico Toras
561.text: "Actually... if he can't hunt, I can still put him out to stud. Wouldn't want to let a good bloodline go to waste."

563.speaker: Rico Toras
563.text: "Let's take him home. I'll figure out what to do with him there."

569.speaker: Hugo Toras
569.text: "Rico, Vina, why don't you two take Bruno back to the palace? His Majesty and I will wrap everything up here."

570.speaker: Narrator
570.text: My uncle gave me a meaningful glance.

572.speaker: Player_Romus
572.text: "Actually, I'd prefer to travel with the princess."

573.speaker: Narrator
573.text: Vina nodded solemnly and turned to Rico.

574.speaker: Vina Toras
574.text: "You can tell me more about Bruno on the way."

579.speaker: Narrator
579.text: The assistants carefully placed Bruno on a blanket in the back of one of the jeeps. Hugo and Rico got in, and the car sped away.

580.speaker: Narrator
580.text: My daughter and I got in the other car and followed them back to the palace.

582.speaker: Vina Toras
582.text: "If it's quite all right, I'll go with Rico. He can tell me more about Bruno on the way."

583.speaker: Narrator
583.text: In front of the university library, a construction crew was hastily pulling a sheet over a large object.

584.speaker: Player_Romus
584.text: "Stop the car at once. I want to see what's under that sheet."

585.speaker: Player_Romus
585.text: "We don't have time to stop. Let's just get to Rico's."

586.speaker: Narrator
586.text: We came to a halt. My guards exited the car and ordered the workers to remove the sheet.

590.speaker: Narrator
590.text: Beneath it was one of the statues I'd commissioned of my father, King Valero.

591.speaker: Narrator
591.text: His head had been chopped off.

595.speaker: Narrator
595.text: Beneath it was one of the statues I'd commissioned earlier in my reign, depicting myself standing beside my father King Valero.

596.speaker: Narrator
596.text: Both of our heads had been chopped off.

597.speaker: Narrator
597.text: Beneath it was one of the statues I'd commissioned earlier in my reign, depicting the Toras lineage: my father, myself, and Vina.

598.speaker: Narrator
598.text: All of our heads had been chopped off.

599.speaker: Player_Romus
599.text: "This is an outrage. The guilty party must be found and punished."

600.speaker: Player_Romus
600.text: "How could Rico have allowed this to happen?"

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "Looks like the good people of Iza are exercising their freedom of expression."

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "Don't worry, Vina. It's only my father they're mad at, not you or me."

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "Don't worry, Vina. I'm sure it's just teenage vandals."

609.speaker: Narrator
609.text: Her face looked noticeably paler. She unconsciously put a hand to her own neck.

610.speaker: Narrator
610.text: She wore a bemused expression on her face.

617.speaker: Vina Toras
617.text: "Do you think Rico wanted us to see this?"

618.speaker: Vina Toras
618.text: "He's trying to crack down on crime here, isn't he? What better excuse than sedition against the royal family?"

620.speaker: Player_Romus
620.text: "That's a good theory, Vina. You're as perceptive as your mother was."

621.speaker: Vina Toras
621.text: "I wonder if Rico wanted us to see this. He's trying to crack down on crime here, isn't he?"

622.speaker: Vina Toras
622.text: "What better excuse than sedition against the royal family?"

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "If he can't keep a few troublemakers from defacing statues, he's not fit to be in charge here."

624.speaker: Player_Romus
624.text: "That's a good theory, Vina. You're as perceptive as your mother was."

625.speaker: Narrator
625.text: Vina unconsciously put a hand to her own neck.

626.speaker: Player_Romus
626.text: "'Sedition' is a strong word. This is just some light hooliganism."

627.speaker: Player_Romus
627.text: "If that's his strategy, it's not a very smart one. He's allowing the authority of House Toras to be undermined."

631.speaker: Narrator
631.text: Her face looked noticeably paler. She unconsciously put a hand to her own neck.

637.speaker: Vina Toras
637.text: "Like Duchess Azaro said, he's in over his head."

638.speaker: Narrator
638.text: She unconsciously put a hand to her own neck.

639.speaker: Player_Romus
639.text: "If he can't keep vandals from defacing royal statues before the King's visit, he doesn't deserve my support."

640.speaker: Player_Romus
640.text: "Either way, this is a disgrace. Order must be brought to Iza one way or another."

641.speaker: Player_Romus
641.text: "This is bigger than just Iza. The anti-monarchist foreign powers are out to get us."

642.speaker: Vina Toras
642.text: "If there's a revolution coming, it doesn't need House Toras' permission."

647.speaker: Player_Romus
647.text: "Talk to me, Vina. What's going on with you?"

648.speaker: Player_Romus
648.text: "Enough with the attitude. You're the Princess of Rizia and I want you on your best behavior for this visit."

650.speaker: Narrator
650.text: She sighed audibly and slouched against the window.

656.speaker: Vina Toras
656.text: "Now can we please get this over with?"

657.speaker: Vina Toras
657.text: "I don't know, Father. Beheading royals is a strong statement, even if they're only made of marble."

658.speaker: Vina Toras
658.text: "Beheading royals strikes me as more than mere 'troublemaking', Father. Even if they're only made of marble."

659.speaker: Vina Toras
659.text: "Then it's good that the King of Rizia is on his way to restore that authority."

660.speaker: Vina Toras
660.text: "I suppose you'll have to hear him out first. Find out what he actually wants."

661.speaker: Vina Toras
661.text: "Good thing the King of Rizia is on his way to restore it."

662.speaker: Vina Toras
662.text: "If that were true, it wouldn't just be statues losing their heads."

664.speaker: Vina Toras
664.text: "I understand, Father. I won't make a scene."

665.speaker: Vina Toras
665.text: "Nothing. Remind me again why I have to be here?"

667.speaker: Player_Romus
667.text: "Because your family has requested your presence, and family is the most important thing in this world."

671.speaker: Player_Romus
671.text: "Because if I leave you alone, you'll start reading that propaganda again."

672.speaker: Player_Romus
672.text: "I want your opinion on the Rico situation. It's valuable to me."

675.speaker: Vina Toras
675.text: "And wake up to the truth about how the world works? Yes, heaven forbid."

676.speaker: Vina Toras
676.text: "And your own daughter's wishes? Those are of no importance?"

680.speaker: Vina Toras
680.text: "If you wanted my opinion, you should've let me on your council."

681.speaker: Vina Toras
681.text: "All right. I'll try to gather all the insight I can."

683.speaker: Narrator
683.text: We rode on in silence until we reached Palas Sazon.

686.speaker: Vina Toras
686.text: "Sorry, Your Majesty. I'll be on my best behavior with Cousin Rico."

698.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
698.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_KingValero"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_KingValeroAndRomus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_TorasFamily"] == true) == false

699.speaker: Narrator
699.text: We passed a street cleaner who was rapidly trying to scrub graffiti off of the side of a building.
699.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_KingValero"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_KingValeroAndRomus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_TorasFamily"] == true) == false

700.speaker: Narrator
700.text: I could just make out the remnants. They read "House Toras Will Fall".

701.speaker: Narrator
701.text: Vina didn't seem to notice. She sighed audibly as she slouched against the window.

705.speaker: Narrator
705.text: Vina didn't seem to notice. She looked lost in thought.

709.speaker: Player_Romus
709.text: "That doesn't mean I approve of the group or its activities."

710.speaker: Rico Toras
710.text: "Of course, of course. You're entitled to your own opinion."

711.speaker: Narrator
711.text: He reached into his vest pocket.

720.speaker: Rico Toras
720.text: "You refused to denounce Su Omina in the face of pressure from Wehlen. For that, we -- they -- are grateful."

721.speaker: Rico Toras
721.text: "But then I got wind of your investigation. Tell me, cousin, do you really think I keep company with terrorists?"

722.speaker: Player_Romus
722.text: "No, I don't. Assuming you are innocent, the investigation will clear your name."

723.speaker: Player_Romus
723.text: "You tell me, Ricardus. Do you have something to hide?"

724.speaker: Rico Toras
724.text: "With regards to Zille? Nothing at all."

735.speaker: Rico Toras
735.text: "The only thing we would need to seal this deal is some additional treasury support and some weapons."

736.speaker: Player_Romus
736.text: "We can't afford to do this right now."

740.speaker: Rico Toras
740.text: "Do you really think I'd dare to bargain with the King of Rizia? Consider it a family favor."
